title: Quantizing Diffusion LLMs under Parallel Decoding: Commitment Risk and the Parallelism Tax
abstract: arXiv:2611.30587v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) are served with accelerated decoders that cache context and commit, in one step, every masked position whose confidence clears a threshold. Yet post-training quantization of dLLMs has so far been calibrated and evaluated under fixed-step samplers without caching. We study W4A4 quantization under the deployed decoder and find that the decoder determines both where quantization harms accuracy and what it costs. Irreversible errors enter chiefly through forced commitments, made when no position clears the threshold: they are a minority of commitments but carry most quantization-induced flips. Quantization also levies a parallelism tax, extra forward passes per response: by compressing top logit gaps, it pushes positions below the threshold while leaving predictions largely intact. translated_title: 并行解码下的扩散大语言模型量化：承诺风险与并行性税
translated_abstract: 扩散大语言模型在实际服务中采用加速解码器，该解码器缓存上下文，并在一步内提交所有置信度超过阈值的掩码位置。然而，迄今为止针对扩散大语言模型的训练后量化都是在无缓存的固定步数采样器下进行校准和评估的。我们在实际部署的解码器下研究了 W4A4 量化，发现解码器既决定了量化在何处损害精度，也决定了其代价是什么。不可逆错误主要通过“强制提交”进入——即在没有任何位置超过阈值时做出的提交：这类提交虽占少数，却承载了大部分由量化引起的预测翻转。量化还会征收一种“并行性税”，即每次响应需要额外的前向传播：量化通过压缩顶部 logit 差距，将位置推至阈值以下，而预测结果本身基本保持不变。我们提出了 DECAL，它利用在实际部署解码器上测得的承诺风险先验，对逐层校准进行重新加权……（原文摘要至此截断）
tldr: 该论文首次在实际部署的缓存式并行解码器下研究扩散大语言模型的 W4A4 量化，揭示了量化误差主要经由“强制承诺”进入、量化还会带来额外的“并行性税”，并提出用承诺风险先验重加权逐层校准的 DECAL 方法来缓解这两个问题。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to study W4A4 quantization of diffusion LLMs under the deployed cache-based parallel decoder, revealing that forced commitments carry most quantization-induced errors and that quantization imposes a "parallelism tax" of extra forward passes, and proposes DECAL, which reweights layer-wise calibration with a commitment-risk prior to mitigate both effects.
